message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.greet: %1$s, stablehand of %2$s: "Boarding's %3$s a week, paid when you take your horse back. Or buy one of ours."
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.none_near: There's no stablehand near enough to talk to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.no_horse: You've no horse of your own close by.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.boarded: %1$s is in a stall now. %2$s will feed, water and brush it; %3$s for each week begun, paid when you take it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.pay_first: %1$s is boarded. Settle up with the stablehand first (%2$s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.cant_pay: That's %s, and you don't have it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.market: Horses for sale at %s's stable today:
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.sold_out: Nothing left for sale today. Come back tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.gone: That horse has already been sold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.bought: The %1$s is yours (%2$s). Treat it well and it will learn to trust you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.too_poor: %1$s shakes their head: the stable can't find %2$s for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.sold: You sold %1$s to the stable for %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.destrier_l: The knight's %s breaks loose, still in its war tack. Earn its trust and it's yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.pony_loose: The raider's %s bolts free. Break it in and it's yours.
